from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    case_type: str = Field(description="The broad nature of the case (e.g., '民事', '行政', '刑事')")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action or charge found in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
